messages.subject: Planned maintenance: document management system (Sat 19 Apr, 6am-10am)
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The firm's document management system (iManage) will be unavailable on Saturday 19 April between 06:00 and 10:00 for scheduled maintenance. Please save and check in any open documents before Friday close. Email and the portal are unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
